privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Coup Master
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Coup Master Privacy Policy: understand which data is used for login, rooms, matches, chat, PWA and ranked stats.
privacy.ogDescription: How Coup Master handles login, room, chat, match and statistics data.
privacy.disclaimer: This document is an operational template for the Coup Master beta project. It describes the current app behavior and should be reviewed by a legal professional before commercial use, broad distribution or sensitive data collection.
privacy.s1Text: Coup Master is a static web app for online multiplayer matches, published as an independent project by Gabriel Barbosa. The app uses Firebase Authentication and Firebase Realtime Database for authentication, room creation, match synchronization, chat and beta statistics.
privacy.s2Intro: Depending on how you use Coup Master, we may process:
privacy.authDataText: Firebase UID, name, profile photo and email when provided through Google sign-in.
privacy.guestLoginText: anonymous UID, temporary name and local session needed to play as a guest.
privacy.roomDataText: room code, players, cards, score, actions, turns, logs, chat, casual or ranked mode, AI bots and results.
privacy.rankedStatsText: games, wins, losses, win rate, score, actions, achievements and markers to avoid duplicate match records.
privacy.localPrefsText: music volume, effects volume, session data, PWA cache and local installation information.
privacy.techDataText: browser, device, access date/time and technical records processed by Firebase, GitHub Pages and integrated services.
privacy.useRooms: create, join, synchronize and close rooms;
privacy.useMatches: run casual and ranked matches in real time;
privacy.useDisplay: display name, photo, status, cards, chat, logs and statistics;
privacy.useStats: record ranked results, achievements and beta competitive history;
privacy.usePwa: keep the PWA working, including static file caching;
privacy.useDebug: investigate bugs, abuse, synchronization failures and compatibility issues.
privacy.s4Text: When applicable, we process data to provide the service requested by you, fulfill obligations related to game operation, preserve match security and integrity, improve the user experience and respond to legitimate support, correction or deletion requests.
privacy.s5Intro: Coup Master depends on external services to work:
privacy.firebaseText: authentication, realtime database and associated infrastructure.
privacy.githubText: hosting for the app's static files.
privacy.tallyText: when you send feedback or suggestions through the integrated form.
privacy.s5Text: We do not sell personal data. Data may be processed by these providers according to their own policies, terms and technical controls.
privacy.s6Text: Chat messages, player names, actions and logs may be visible to other participants in the same room. Avoid entering personal data, sensitive information, passwords, documents or content you do not want to share with other players.
privacy.s7Text: The app may use local storage, session storage, browser cache and Service Worker to keep login, preferences, PWA installation and static files. You can clear this data through your browser or operating system settings.
privacy.s8Text: Rooms may be automatically removed after inactivity. Ranked results and statistics may remain while ranked mode is in beta, to support history and debugging. You may request access, correction or deletion of your data through the project channel.
privacy.s9Text: We use Firebase authentication, security rules and client-side validations to reduce risks. Even so, the project is beta, runs mostly on the client and should not be treated as a definitive anti-fraud system. Do not share sensitive information inside the game.
privacy.s10Text: Coup Master is not directed to children. If you are underage, use the app only with authorization and supervision from a legal guardian.
privacy.s11Text: When applicable, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, deletion, portability, information about sharing and review of automated decisions. The response will depend on identifying your account and the technical limitations of the beta environment.
privacy.s12Text: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect new features, Firebase changes, changes to ranked mode, PWA, chat, statistics or legal obligations. The date at the top indicates the current version.
privacy.contactText: For privacy-related requests, use the project's official GitHub channel:

terms.metaDescription: Coup Master Terms of Service: usage rules, accounts, matches, beta ranked mode, AI bots, chat and project limitations.
terms.ogDescription: Coup Master usage rules for casual and ranked matches.
terms.disclaimer: These Terms are a base template to professionalize the project. They describe the expected rules for using Coup Master in beta and should be legally reviewed before commercial use.
terms.s1Text: By accessing or using Coup Master, you agree to these Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.s2Text: Coup Master is an online beta game that runs in the browser, with casual mode, ranked mode, private rooms, chat, PWA, experimental AI bots and competitive statistics in development.
terms.s3Text: Coup Master is an independent project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by the owners of the Coup game, publishers, brands or third parties. Names, rules and references may belong to their respective owners.
terms.s4Text1: You may sign in with Google or, when available, as an anonymous guest. Some features, such as ranked statistics, may require a Google account to associate results with a profile.
terms.s4Text2: You are responsible for keeping your account secure and for not using names, photos, messages or content that violate third-party rights or harm other players.
terms.s5Text: Casual mode works as a free table. The host can configure the deck, add bots, remove players and conduct the match. Rules may depend on consensus among players.
terms.s6Text: Ranked mode applies automated rules through the system, has no administrative host and may allow experimental AI bots in the waiting room. Scores, achievements, ranking and statistics are still beta features and may be recalculated, adjusted, reset or suspended during testing.
terms.conductHarass: harass, threaten, stalk, humiliate or attack other players;
terms.conductOffensive: use offensive, discriminatory, sexualized, illegal language or language that encourages violence;
terms.conductExploit: exploit bugs, manipulate Firebase, automate abusive actions or try to bypass rules;
terms.conductSpam: send spam, dangerous links, malicious code or content that violates third-party rights;
terms.conductAccess: try to access, change or delete room, user or statistics data without authorization.
terms.s8Text: You are responsible for messages, names and other content you enter. The project may limit, remove or block content and access when there is abuse, technical risk or violation of these Terms.
terms.s9Text: Coup Master is provided in beta, without a guarantee of continuous availability. Rooms may expire, data may be removed, features may change and matches may be interrupted by network, Firebase, browser, PWA or project update failures.
terms.s10Text: Code, interface, texts, visual organization and original Coup Master materials belong to the project or its authors, unless indicated otherwise. You do not receive a license to copy, resell, host a misleading version or use the project to impersonate the original author.
terms.s11Text: The app is provided "as is". To the fullest extent permitted by law, the project is not responsible for indirect losses, interruptions, incorrect data, bugs, incompatibilities, disputes between players or decisions made based on beta statistics.
